objective: Identify a source-traceable and publication-time-computable feature system for article-level scientific novelty evidence and potential future scholarly impact, without modifying or importing the ASPR experiment code.

included: Direct article-level novelty evidence available when the focal paper is published.
Publication-time properties of the focal paper, its cited knowledge, topic position, team, and pre-existing networks that prior research associates with later scholarly attention, use, or diffusion.
Field, year, and venue-family context needed to prevent opportunity differences from being misread as scientific substance.
Adverse, null, and mixed evidence needed to screen biased or weak predictors.
excluded: Any citation, download, altmetric, diffusion, disruption, or uptake observed after the focal paper is published.
Current journal impact factors or author/institution prestige measured after publication.
Protected attributes, inferred demographics, country prestige, institution prestige, or other variables that directly encode structural status hierarchies.
Dynamic LLM judgments without a frozen model, prompt, training cutoff, input corpus, and deterministic aggregation rule.
Treating citation potential as scientific quality, correctness, social value, or innovation truth.

innovation_evidence.interpretation: Evidence that a paper recombines prior knowledge in a historically new configuration. It is not inferred from future success.
innovation_evidence.allowed_use: Primary innovation feature block and ablation.

substantive_potential.interpretation: Publication-time scientific-positioning properties that may shape later use: combination profile, knowledge diversity, reference-age search, and topic momentum.
substantive_potential.allowed_use: Separate potential-impact predictor block; never relabeled as direct novelty.

opportunity_visibility.interpretation: Team reach, bibliographic-network position, venue context, access, and presentation properties that may change discovery or citation opportunity.
opportunity_visibility.allowed_use: Separately reported opportunity block and sensitivity analysis.

context_control.interpretation: Field, subfield, year, and publication-format context.

maximum_information_time.focal_metadata: Known no later than the focal publication record.
maximum_information_time.focal_references: Declared by the focal paper at publication.
maximum_information_time.historical_counts_and_graphs: Use only papers, references, citations, team records, and network edges with year strictly less than the focal publication year.
maximum_information_time.static_taxonomy_caveat: Frozen OpenAlex topic and subfield labels may be used as a retrospective static content taxonomy. All topic counts remain strictly prior. The taxonomy version must be frozen and topic-derived results reported as an extended block.

future_outcomes_allowed_later_as_labels: field-year-normalized citation uptake at prespecified horizons
outcome_separation.label_rule: All feature definitions, roles, and screening decisions must be frozen and hashed before any label is joined.

discovery_channels: backward and forward citation chaining from reviews and foundational studies
review_design.review_use_rule: Reviews and meta-analyses may establish search coverage, interpretation limits, and evidence consistency; a review alone cannot authorize a new mathematical feature formula.
review_design.source_inclusion_rule: Include peer-reviewed research that defines, applies, validates, contradicts, or bounds an article-level novelty or publication-time scholarly-impact predictor. Retain null and adverse evidence.
review_design.feature_extraction_unit: One mathematical or categorical feature family. Parameter choices, monotone transforms, missing indicators, and model-learned interactions are not counted as independent feature families.
review_design.search_snapshot_rule: Public database rankings are frozen with provider, query, rank, identifier, title, year, type, and URL. Later reruns create a new version rather than overwriting this snapshot.

feature_admission.default_training_rule: Default features must pass all hard gates and must not be designated sensitivity-only.
feature_admission.extended_training_rule: Features derivable from complete frozen inputs but not yet materialized are retained in an explicitly separate extended set.
feature_admission.sensitivity_rule: Restricted-corpus proxies, weak presentation correlates, and mathematical composites of retained components are sensitivity features rather than default features.

local_provenance.reuse_boundary: Only formulas, T0 definitions, data availability, outcome-blind quality audits, and the independently selected two novelty indicators are reused. Existing ASPR prediction outcomes are not read.
